title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew — Wednesday, September 16, 2026

WEATHER — Sunny and mild. High 82°F, low 64°F, rain chance under 5%, light winds. A near-perfect fall day — light layers, no umbrella needed.

HEADLINES
- Von der Leyen proposes making Canada the EU's first associate member — a notable pivot as Trump-era tariffs push Ottawa toward Europe.
- Saudi Arabia accuses Yemen's Houthi rebels of an attempted attack on Mecca, drawing broad regional condemnation.
- Senate health committee holds a confirmation hearing for surgeon general and two other top health nominees today.
- EU-backed court convicts former Kosovo president Hashim Thaçi of war crimes, sentencing him to 25 years.

GETTING AROUND — No major systemwide issues this morning. Heads-up for later: G line signal work resumes this weekend (Sep 18–21), so plan Brooklyn trips around it.

NYC TODAY
- Harry Styles: Together, Together at Madison Square Garden, 8 PM.
- Lil Wayne — 20 Years of Carter Classics at Jones Beach, 8 PM. Plus free midday TSQ Live music in Times Square.

NUGGET — The autumnal equinox is next week (Sep 22), but today already gives you the payoff: near-equal day and night, and the best light of the year for a walk across the Brooklyn Bridge around golden hour.
